svg.title: Vale stops Riju just before he activates a total rollback.
svg.desc: Riju's hand hangs just above the rollback control. Vale places a gloved hand beside his wrist rather than seizing it and warns that a total rollback would erase accurate records along with false conclusions.
svg.text: Page 48, panel 1 · Side close shot as Vale stops the rollback

text.tspan: Vale prevents an impulsive rollback and redirects
the decision towards the full audit.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
